newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Union Bank to issue new shares in merger.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Union Bank to issue new shares in merger.

text.p: Estonia's Union Bank said on Tuesday that it will issue new shares worth between 30 to 50 million kroons which it will swap for shares in North Estonia Bank, with which it plans to merge.
Union Bank announced the merger plan on Sunday and said the new bank would be the second largest bank in the Baltic state after market leader, Hansapank.
Union Bank also said the losses made by North Estonia Bank and covered by the government and central bank amounted to 150 million kroons.
Before the merger was announced, the goverment stake in North Estonia Bank was 50 percent and the central bank held 33 percent. They have now handed over their shareholdings to Union Bank.
Union Bank is quoted both in Helsinki and Tallinn.
